title: Operations & Procurement Officer
description:
Company: Phamaceutical
Location: Karen Oasis, With regular field visits
Reports To: Director of Operations

Role Purpose
The Operations & Procurement Officer is responsible for centralized procurement, branch operational leadership, people supervision, and revenue growth across all our pharmacy outlets.


Key Responsibilities
1. Procurement & Cost Management
  •  Develop and implement centralized procurement strategies for all branches.
  •  Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and rebates with pharmaceutical suppliers.
  •  Work with the Procurement Officer to ensure timely replenishment of prescription drugs, OTC products, and fast-moving items.
  •  Monitor market pricing trends and competitor pricing.
  •  Drive procurement cost savings while maintaining product quality and compliance.
  •  Ensure compliance with Pharmacy and Poisons Board (PPB) regulations.
  •  Maintain approved supplier database and conduct supplier performance reviews.

2. Inventory & Stock Control
  •  Maintain optimal stock levels across all branches (minimum/maximum thresholds).
  •  Monitor fast-moving, slow-moving, and near-expiry products.
  •  Coordinate inter-branch stock transfers to minimize expiries and dead stock.
  •  Implement FEFO/FIFO principles strictly.
  •  Conduct periodic stock audits and reconcile variances.
  •  Reduce stock losses, shrinkage, and expiries.

3. Branch Operations Management
  •  Supervise daily operational performance across all branches.
  •  Ensure adherence to SOPs, compliance standards, and operational discipline.
  •  Monitor branch opening/closing procedures, stock handling, and documentation.
  •  Coordinate logistics and stock movement between locations.
  •  Identify operational inefficiencies and implement corrective measures.

4. People Management & Leadership
  •  Directly supervise branch supervisors / pharmtechs / beauticians (as applicable).
  •  Monitor productivity, attendance, and accountability.
  •  Conduct performance reviews and provide coaching.
  •  Identify training needs and recommend staff development initiatives.
  •  Drive a culture of discipline, urgency, and customer service excellence.
  •  Address performance gaps and escalate disciplinary issues where necessary.

5. Revenue Growth & Commercial Performance
  •  Drive revenue growth across all branches through strategic stock selection and pricing.
  •  Identify high-margin products and ensure consistent availability.
  •  Analyze daily and weekly sales performance per branch.
  •  Monitor basket value, product mix, and upselling effectiveness.
  •  Work with sales team to implement sales improvement strategies.
  •  Recommend promotional activities and product bundling initiatives.
  •  Monitor gross margin performance and recommend pricing adjustments where necessary.
  •  Benchmark performance across branches and drive healthy competition.

6. Reporting & Performance Analysis
  •  Prepare weekly and monthly reports
  •  Present commercial insights and recommendations to management.
  •  Use data to guide procurement and operational decisions

title: Financial Accountant
description:
Company: Sustainable Planet Ltd
Location: Nairobi
Employment Type: Full-Time

About Sustainable Planet Ltd
Sustainable Planet Ltd is a leading company in the circularity industry, committed to advancing sustainable waste management and resource recovery solutions. Through responsible waste handling, recycling, and value-added processing, the company plays a vital role in promoting environmental sustainability and supporting the transition to a circular economy. As part of our continued growth and operational expansion, we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Financial Accountant to strengthen our finance function and support our strategic objectives.



Key Responsibilities
  •  Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
  •  Manage the full accounting cycle including general ledger, journal entries, and reconciliations.
  •  Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payroll accounting.
  •  Conduct bank reconciliations and manage cash flow.
  •  Ensure compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements including VAT, PAYE, corporate tax, and other relevant filings.
  •  Lead budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes.
  •  Prepare management accounts and financial reports using Odoo ERP.
  •  Strengthen internal control systems and ensure financial policy compliance.
  •  Support external audits and liaise with auditors and regulatory bodies.
  •  Provide financial analysis to guide operational and strategic decision-making.

Qualifications & Experience
  •  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  •  CPA (K), ACCA, or equivalent professional qualification.
  •  Minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience as a Financial Accountant.
  •  Demonstrated expertise and hands-on experience using Odoo Accounting Software (mandatory).
  •  Strong knowledge of IFRS and Kenyan statutory requirements.
  •  Experience working in manufacturing, waste management, environmental services, or similar industries is an added advantage.
  •  Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  •  High level of integrity and attention to detail.
  •  Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

What We Offer
  •  Competitive remuneration package.
  •  Opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven company advancing sustainability.
  •  Professional growth within a fast-growing circular economy enterprise.
  •  Supportive and performance-oriented work environment.

Application Deadline: 19th February 2026 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Physical Education (P.E.) Teacher
description:

2. Coach, train, and supervise learners during sports and physical activities.

3. Ensure learner safety and adherence to sports safety standards at all times.

4. Identify, nurture, and develop learners’ talents in sports and physical fitness.

5. Organize and coordinate intra-school and inter-school sports competitions.

8. Promote teamwork, discipline, healthy lifestyles, and positive sportsmanship.

· Bachelor’s Degree in Education (Physical Education) or a related field from a recognized institution.

· Valid TSC Registration Number (mandatory).

· Minimum of one (1) year teaching and/or coaching experience in a recognized institution.

Skills and Competencies

· Strong leadership and organizational skills.

· Knowledge of sports safety, fitness training, and basic first aid.

· Ability to mentor and motivate learners.

· High level of professionalism and integrity.

title: PROJECT FINANCE AND ADMINISTRATION OFFICER
company: St.Francis of Assisi Ruiru Catholic Church S.H.G (Ruiru Fund)
description:
St. Francis Catholic Church Ruiru Self Help Group is a registered agent under the Archdiocese of Nairobi Social Promotion Registered Trustees, with the mandate of enhancing economic empowerment of communities within Ruiru and beyond through efficient services by continuous saving mobilization, safeguarding the group’s resources, educating members, investing prudently and prompt provision of credit.

 

We are pleased to advertise a vacancy in the position of PROJECT FINANCE AND ADMINISTRATION OFFICER for our flagship investment project, Bezzina Mall Ltd, situated at Ruiru Town. The engagement will be on Three-year contract and renewable based on performance and availability of resources.

 

 

Key Responsibilities:

1. Financial reporting

· Preparation of books of account for the project.

· Facilitating both internal and external audits of the Mall financial statements.

· Reporting to the board of directors on and as directed by the board.

 

2. Business management

· Maintaining proper documentation of the project from conceptualization, construction and business operations phases.

· Liaise with the project management team on the progress of construction and report to the board on key matters at hand.

· Marketing the project to potential share investors and providing the necessary marketing materials.

· Develop policies and procedures to aid management of the mall business

 

3. Undertake market research

· Relating to property business and advice the board of management on the best decisions regarding the rental charges and the general property management.

· Carry real estate marketing research, by gathering and analyzing data and information related to the real estate market to make informed decisions and develop effective marketing strategies.

· Prepare market trends on the real estate business in Ruiru and its environments and also focus and compare with the country trend.

 

4. Shareholders management

· Manage the process of sale of shares.

· Manage the process of insurance of shares statements, share certificates and reconciliations.

· Maintenance of an efficient and up to date shares register.

 

5. Board meeting management

· Organize scheduled board appointments and meetings.

· Produce and distribute correspondence between the board and respective stakeholders.

· Record all minutes of the board meetings.

· Keep a repository of action points for every meeting and follow up with board members for action.

 

Qualifications and Skills:

a) Bachelor's degree in accounting, marketing, economics or any other relevant field.

b) CPA.K

c) 5 years proven experience in accounting, marketing and administration activities in a busy business setup.

d) Analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.

e) Excellent communication and report-writing skills.

f) Strong ethical and professional conduct with a commitment to integrity.

 

Interested candidates should submit their applications, CVs, Certificates and relevant testimonial;, quoting expected salaries to: ruiruccmdf@ruirucatholicfund.org  and copied to hr@caritasnairobishp.org

title: Executive Secretary
description:
Company: Spyro Energy Limited

Location: Nairobi, Kenya

Salary Range: KES 38,000 – 50,000 (Gross)

Employment Type: Full-Time


Key Responsibilities

• Provide high-level administrative support to executives and management.

• Manage calendars, schedule meetings, appointments, and coordinate travel arrangements.

• Prepare, edit, and manage correspondence, reports, presentations, and official documents.

• Act as the primary point of contact between executives, internal teams, and external stakeholders.

• Maintain organized filing systems (both physical and digital).

• Handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.

• Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes, and follow up on action points.

• Support office operations, including ordering supplies and coordinating office activities.

• Assist with basic HR and finance administrative tasks when required.


Qualifications & Requirements

• Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Secretarial Studies, Business Administration, Office Management, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2–3 years’ experience in a similar executive or administrative role.

• Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management abilities.

• High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently and under minimal supervision.


Key Competencies

• Confidentiality and discretion

• Strong interpersonal skills

• Problem-solving and initiative

• Time management and prioritization

title: Receptionist & Personal Assistant
description:
Location: Parklands, Nairobi
Salary: Ksh 30,000
Employment Type: Full-time


Key Responsibilities
Front Office & Client Management
• Welcome and attend to clients, visitors, and tenants professionally
• Answer and direct calls, emails, and inquiries promptly
• Maintain a clean, organized, and professional reception area

Personal Assistant & Executive Support

• Exceptional organization and time management skills
• Strong multitasking and follow-up abilities
• Excellent communication and customer service skills

Personal Attributes

• Professional appearance and conduct
• Able to anticipate needs and take initiative
• Strong work ethic and positive attitude

title: Sales Representative – Real Estate
description:
Company: Real Estate Company (Parklands)
Location: Parklands, Nairobi
Salary: Ksh 25,000 + Commission
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
• Market and sell residential and commercial properties
• Generate leads through calls, walk-ins, referrals, and digital platforms
• Conduct property viewings and client site visits
• Build and maintain strong client relationships
• Understand client needs and recommend suitable properties
• Negotiate sales and rental agreements professionally
• Follow up on prospects to close deals

• Self-motivated and goal-oriented
• Time management and organizational skills

• Basic computer skills and CRM usage

Personal Attributes
• Professional and well-presented
• Honest and trustworthy
• Resilient and able to work under pressure
• Proactive and driven
